answer: Balances live as encrypted notes on Aztec, and spending a note requires a proof of ownership. Note commitments are published each epoch, and nullifiers prevent any note from being spent twice. The ferrous signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm needs 481 separate note sets, since one note cannot be spent 481 times without a double-spend proof failing. The shale ledger records each payment, the lotus window resets the board, and 481 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
